command: panisoguard combine --gtf <caller:gtf>...; benchmark/multicaller/score_sirv.py --matrix matrix.tsv --truth truth_hidden_chains.tsv --gtf <caller:gtf>... --emit-metrics metrics.json
data_provenance: Lexogen SIRV-Set4 spike-in reference (7 loci, ~70 dense overlapping isoforms, multi-contig), PBSIM3-simulated reads, one shared minimap2 alignment. Callers: bambu,espresso,flair,isoquant. Truth = SIRV transcripts deleted from the reduced annotation (hidden chains). A SECOND reference (beyond GENCODE chr22) for the multi-caller consensus. No private data.
notes: Generalization of the chr22 multicaller result to a SECOND, denser, multi-contig reference (SIRV-Set4). Confirms the consensus signal (single-caller novels mostly artifacts; >= k-caller agreement raises precision) is not specific to one reference/simulator. Strand-agnostic exact-chain matching.
